topic: Managing Employee Bank Details and Payment Mode for Salary
summary: This section in the employee master allows you to record an employee's bank details and specify their preferred salary payment mode, which will then reflect on their salary slips.
steps: Click on the employee's record to view their details.
Locate the 'Salary Details' section within the employee's profile.
Enter the 'Bank Name', 'Branch', 'Account Number', and 'IFSC Code' for the employee.
In the 'Payment Mode' field, specify the method of payment, such as 'RTGS' for bank transfers or 'Cheque' for cheque payments.
Click 'Save' (typically at the bottom of the employee master page) to apply the changes.
business_rules: The bank details and payment mode entered here will be reflected on the employee's generated salary slips.
important_notes: This information is saved once in the employee master and will be used for all future salary processes unless manually updated.
Accurate bank details are crucial for timely and correct salary disbursements.
questions: How do I add an employee's bank details for salary payment?
